description: Functional spec: POST /e2e/ai-credentials runs through the existing browser, BO-node, and BO-auth pipelines and therefore requires the normal session cookie and CSRF token. Tests first: add route/controller coverage for accepted authenticated requests and rejected requests missing regular auth/CSRF. Mocking: none; use ConnCase and the real Accounts/System boundaries.

comments.text: Implemented route protection with the existing browser, bo_node_only, and bo_auth pipelines. Added authenticated and unauthenticated integration coverage; no custom auth pipeline or plug.

title: [zaq-x2b.1] Protect AI credential seed with existing BO auth
